title: Resume your coding agent sessions on any machine
summary: Atuin's creator syncs Claude Code and Codex sessions across machines; she says an agent found a past investigation and fixed an upload outage faster.
agent_role: Agents search earlier sessions, pick up past investigations and continue work on another machine; the author starts tasks and decides where to move them.
outcome: The author reports an agent found a previous investigation into broken avatar uploads and built the fix faster than starting from scratch.
what_they_did: The developer of the Atuin terminal tool built a way to save, search and sync coding agent sessions across machines. Her agents can also search past sessions themselves. She moved a slow-disk investigation from a server to her laptop mid-session.
how_it_went: She says a daily error-checking agent spotted a broken storage key, and a second agent found that earlier work and built the fix quickly. The moved session continued where it left off and found more speedups.
worth_knowing: Session capture is opt-in and synced history is encrypted end to end; you can also keep it all local.
prompt: Before starting on [task], search my past agent sessions for earlier attempts at it. Summarize what was tried, why each attempt was dropped, and what you would do differently. Show me a plan and wait for my approval before changing any code.

curation.rationale: Mainly a product launch, but the author gives concrete examples of agents reusing past sessions to fix an outage and finishing a benchmark on another machine. Light evidence and self-promotional.
